technicalNotes.title: Calculation Notes
technicalNotes.stocking: Stocking count = pond area × stocking density.
technicalNotes.survival: Final fish count = stocking count × survival rate.
technicalNotes.biomass: Harvest biomass = final fish count ÷ harvest size (fish/kg).
technicalNotes.seedCost: Total seed cost = seed price × stocking count.
technicalNotes.feedCost: Total feed cost = feed price × total feed.
technicalNotes.electricity: Total electricity cost = monthly electricity cost × cultivation cycle.
technicalNotes.expenses: Total expenses = seed cost + feed cost + electricity cost + other costs.
technicalNotes.grossRevenue: Gross revenue = fish selling price × harvest biomass.
technicalNotes.netRevenue: Net revenue = gross revenue − total expenses.
technicalNotes.rcRatio: R/C ratio = gross revenue ÷ total expenses. R/C ≥ 1 is categorized as Feasible.
technicalNotes.aerator: The estimated number of aerators is rounded up based on the minimum reference biomass capacity per unit.
technicalNotes.oxygen: Oxygen requirements use the previous calculator's reference value of 700 mg O₂/kg/hour.
technicalNotes.limitations: The calculation does not account for all technical factors, including pond depth, water conditions, oxygen distribution, and actual aerator configuration.
technicalNotes.general: All results are estimates based on the entered parameters and the supplied cultivation materials. Technical validation is recommended before implementation.

dataUsage.description: The information we collect may be used for purposes related to providing and improving Crustea's services.
items: Responding to your questions and requests.
Providing information about products and services.
Improving the quality of our products, services, and user experience.
Analyzing website usage for further development.
Maintaining website security and preventing misuse.
Complying with applicable laws and regulations.

cookies.title: Cookies and Analytics
cookies.paragraph1: Crustea's website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve the user experience, understand how the website is used, and optimize website performance.
cookies.paragraph2: Cookies may be used to store certain preferences, understand usage patterns, and help us analyze website performance.
cookies.paragraph3: You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. However, some parts of the website may not function optimally if cookies are disabled.

thirdParties.title: Third Parties
thirdParties.paragraph1: To operate our website and services, we may use third-party providers that support specific functions, such as analytics, hosting, communication, security, or other technology services.
thirdParties.paragraph2: These third parties may access information only to the extent necessary to provide services to us and are expected to handle information in accordance with applicable requirements.
thirdParties.paragraph3: We do not sell users' personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

storageSecurity.title: Data Storage and Security
storageSecurity.paragraph1: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to help protect the information we manage from unauthorized access, use, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
storageSecurity.paragraph2: Information is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, provide services, meet legal obligations, or resolve disputes.
storageSecurity.paragraph3: Although we strive to protect information, no method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

userRights.title: User Rights
userRights.description: Depending on applicable law, users may have certain rights regarding their personal information.
items: Request information about the personal data we hold about you.
Request deletion of information where permitted by law.
Withdraw consent to certain data uses when processing is based on consent.
Submit questions or objections regarding the use of personal information.
userRights.closing: To exercise these rights, you can contact us using the contact information provided at the end of this policy.

externalLinks.title: Third-Party Links
externalLinks.paragraph1: Crustea's website may provide links to third-party websites, platforms, or services.
externalLinks.paragraph2: This Privacy Policy applies only to websites and services operated by Crustea. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, security, or content of third-party websites.
externalLinks.paragraph3: We recommend reviewing the privacy policy of each third-party website you visit.

policyChanges.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
policyChanges.paragraph1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, technology, operational needs, or applicable legal requirements.
policyChanges.paragraph2: Any changes will be published on this page with an appropriate update date. We recommend that users review this page periodically.
